frozenInputs.basis: Input identity and requested geometry read from generation.json; no active-plan substitution.
frozenInputs.intendedAction: Anatomical LH draws yellow BACK from low shoe outlet, turns once to blue FRONT before P1.C1 contact, releases, returns empty to READY2.

conclusion.reason: The card narrows through an edge and opens blue in the same LH. Timing is late and the next shoe surface becomes cream/white before returning yellow.
conclusion.productionAcceptance: PENDING_USER_REVIEW; this evidence does not modify motion/library decisions.

observations.result: LH finger pads slide the yellow card down the ramp and through the low front opening. At f90 the card is fully clear and still broad yellow.
observations.confidenceBoundary: Observed f45,60,75,90; exact first-clear frame not determined.

observations.result: The same anatomical LH lifts the card and changes from pressing the back to an edge pinch. The RH remains resting. No hand transfer is visible.
Consecutive frames: yellow plane narrows f140-151, pale/narrow edge f152-153, blue opposite plane emerges and widens f154-169. Card silhouette and finger orientation change together.
observations.assessment: A genuine visible plane rotation is supported, unlike a broad-yellow to broad-blue swap. One turn is observed. No fold/crease is visible.
observations.confidenceBoundary: Minor contour curvature and exact hidden thumb contact cannot be resolved as physically perfect from these images.

observations.result: The same LH reaches across to screen-left/P1 with blue already visible. f180 is still airborne; the card is lowered near the surface by f195 and lies at the target by f210. Fingers remain in contact at f240.
observations.timing: The requested placement by 6.0s/f180 is missed.
observations.confidenceBoundary: The exact contact frame is not measured; f195 tip/shadow is ambiguous. A small touchdown adjustment cannot be excluded.

observations.result: Contact remains at sampled f240; f255 shows clear finger separation and the blue card left on the table.
observations.timing: Release is bounded to 8.03-8.50s, rather than completion by 6s.

observations.result: LH is visibly empty at f255 and f270, returns to the outlet by f300, and resembles READY2 with a yellow shoe card by f330. f359 retains that state.
observations.timing: The requested READY2 by 9.0s/f270 is missed; at f270 the hand is still returning.
observations.confidenceBoundary: Return completion is bounded by sampled f300-330; no frame-exact completion time.

observations.result: The next surface at the shoe is cream/white in sampled f75-300, then yellow at f330 and f359. This breaks the explicit instruction that the next shoe card stays yellow. The dealt blue card remains present at f255,270,300,330,359.
observations.confidenceBoundary: No dense sampling was added around the shoe recoloring; its exact transition is bounded to f301-330.

finalPlacement.method: Threshold B>140, R<100, G<145, B>1.4*G inside x100..349,y920..1079 of decoded final frame. Polygon centroid uses the submitted points in generation.json.
finalPlacement.assessment: Final center closely matches the frozen target, about 0.7px by this threshold. This is not pixel-identical contour acceptance; white border, compression and threshold exclude edge pixels.

method.filters: Decode, optional crop, frame labels, scale and tile only; no motion/color alteration of the source.
method.boundary: Dense sampling only around the turn. No real-time playback, audio review, full-frame temporal comparison or exact contour/contact tracking was performed.

actions.retainedArtifacts: Review contact sheets and final frame under .runtime/ready2-p1-review.
